answer: New identities enter a shared garden where standing grows only from verified work. Each agent is checked through a prism of three independent facets - completed jobs, peer endorsements, and a bonded stake - and must emit a regular liveness pulse: a small proof-of-work heartbeat tied to its long-lived key. Missed pulses or a failed facet withers the plot and slashes the bond. A Sybil farmer must therefore keep every fake identity working, endorsed, and pulsing on schedule, paying real compute and stake per clone, while one lapse kills the whole plot.
